protocol.checkpoint_selection: secondary checkpoint by equal-weight mean all-cohort validation AP across regimes; earliest tie; empty support is an error

decision.auxiliary_interaction: (detached-aux minus coupled-aux) minus (detached-noaux minus coupled-noaux), paired within seed and training policy
decision.backbone_adaptation: detached-aux minus frozen-aux; fixed parameters still have dynamically replayed memory
decision.falsification: persistent routing benefit without auxiliary weakens auxiliary-conflict necessity; similar fixed-backbone performance weakens an auxiliary-trained-backbone explanation; retain all opposite/null directions
decision.limits: controls change complete training trajectories including head/state feedback; they cannot identify a unique local gradient-conflict cause

diagnostics.coverage: disjoint exhaustive parameter groups; full ECTG, not only the P003 context projection
diagnostics.measurement: prediction gradient then auxiliary accumulation increment; dependent probes, floating-point cancellation limits
diagnostics.movement: per-group initial and epoch parameter hashes, L2 and maximum absolute displacement; Adam movement is not inferred from raw gradient magnitude

protocol.evaluation_partition: validation only; test events removed before model construction
protocol.inference: descriptive development; already inspected prefixes; no significance, causal generalization or test evidence

interventions.auxiliary_off: skip observation-loss backward entirely; keep full observation forward, stochastic draws, memory updates and reported auxiliary value
interventions.fixed_control_identity: detached-noaux must keep backbone parameter hashes unchanged; exact equivalence to frozen-noaux is an integration invariant, not an extra scored arm
interventions.frozen_arm: detached query; set only backbone parameters requires_grad=false from initialization; keep auxiliary learning in remaining heads and full dynamic memory
interventions.initialization: same bounded decoder initialization and all initial parameter bytes across every arm and policy within each seed
interventions.optimizer: Adam over parameters with requires_grad=true; zero_grad(set_to_none=true); a parameter with no gradient receives no weight-decay update

protocol.primary_endpoint: fixed final epoch validation AP/AUC, paired auxiliary-by-routing interaction separately under each training policy

runtime.reference_arms: rerun coupled-aux and detached-aux in this runtime; never use earlier environment scores as paired controls

sampling.budget: one negative per supported positive; common candidate draws across arms

protocol.secondary_endpoint: detached-aux minus frozen-aux at fixed final epoch; auxiliary effect within each routing arm

runtime.boundary: Wheel hashes checked at installation; installed RECORD and base Python payload checked here. This is not a container or a promise of bitwise equality across CPU hardware.
